title: The Price of Current-Effect Inference in Nonstationary Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.29982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive experiments use bandit algorithms to favor interventions with higher expected rewards. However, decision-makers also require reliable inference on current treatment effects: differences between intervention and reference-arm mean rewards at the present time, rather than historical averages. These objectives conflict: reward maximization favors better interventions, whereas current-effect inference requires continued exploration of potentially suboptimal interventions as outcomes change over time. We characterize this tradeoff for $K$-arm bandits with H\"older-smooth mean rewards of exponent $\beta\in(0,1]$ and constant $L$. Requiring high-probability simultaneous coverage of all current effects by confidence intervals of width at most $w$, we establish matching minimax bounds, up to logarithmic factors, on expected dynamic regret. translated_title: 非平稳多臂老虎机中现时效应推断的代价
translated_abstract: 自适应实验利用老虎机算法来偏好具有更高期望收益的干预措施。然而，决策者还需要对现时处理效应进行可靠的推断：即在当前时刻干预措施与参照臂平均收益之间的差异，而非历史平均。这两个目标相互冲突：收益最大化倾向于选择更优的干预，而现时效应推断则要求随着结果随时间变化，持续探索可能次优的干预。我们针对平均收益具有指数 β∈(0,1] 和常数 L 的 Hölder 平滑性的 K 臂老虎机刻画了这一权衡。在要求置信区间以不超过 w 的宽度、以高概率同时覆盖所有现时效应的条件下，我们在期望动态遗憾上建立了（在对数因子范围内）匹配的极小极大界。在时间跨度 T 内，我们的算法 TRACE（Tracking Rewards and Current Effects）实现了遗憾……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了非平稳多臂老虎机中收益最大化与现时效应推断之间的内在权衡，证明了以有限宽度置信区间同时覆盖所有现时效应所需付出的动态遗憾极小极大代价，并提出 TRACE 算法来同时兼顾这两个目标。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the fundamental tradeoff between reward maximization and current-effect inference in nonstationary multi-armed bandits, establishes matching minimax bounds on the dynamic regret price of achieving simultaneous confidence coverage of all current effects, and proposes the TRACE algorithm to attain both objectives.
